persuasionAngle.rationale: This segment's core tension is being seen as elite, not just 'good for her age.' The ad should mirror back the identity she's building — not aspirational, but declarative. She already IS this. The gear is confirmation, not transformation.
persuasionAngle.psychFramework: Self-concept congruity — purchase decisions align with who the buyer believes she already is, not who she wants to become.

creative.headline: Born for this.
creative.subtitle: ANIKA ROSS  ///  TRACK & FIELD
creative.tone: Declarative. No question marks, no qualifiers. A statement of fact.
creative.visualDirection: Young Black female sprinter crouched in starting blocks, muscles taut, eyes locked forward. Dramatic side lighting casting hard shadows. Track surface visible but background falls to deep black. Shot tight — waist up. Power and stillness before explosion.
creative.imagePrompt: Dramatic high-contrast photo of a young athletic Black woman in starting blocks on a running track, powerful build, intense focused expression looking straight ahead, cinematic side lighting from the left creating hard shadows, dark moody background fading to black, professional sports photography, shot on Canon EOS R5 85mm f/1.4, editorial Nike style, no text no logos
